title: 第7章 她说，她找到了亡母旧人
lines: 她端坐在主位，指尖轻轻敲着茶盏。
像在说一件无关紧要的事。
站在下首的管事低声道：
“老太君一事、宴席一事、还有今日小姐那边……”
尸体被抬出来时，全府震动。
更震动的，是她手里紧紧攥着的一封信。
“毒药已换好，待老太君再服一剂，三日必亡。”
content_zh:
相府的风，越来越紧。

    紧到连下人走路都开始低头，不敢多说一句话。

    因为所有人都知道——

    那个被打了一巴掌还敢还手的嫡女苏晚，已经不再是“能欺负的人”。

    但苏柔不信。

    她不可能信。

    午后，西偏院外。

    苏柔站在门口。

    身后跟着两名贴身丫鬟，还有一名医女。

    她今日穿得格外素净，连发饰都少了几分华丽。

    看起来像是“来赔罪”的。

    但她的眼神，不是。

    那是一种压着刀的平静。

    她抬手，轻轻敲门。

    “姐姐。”

    声音柔得几乎发软。

    “我来看看你。”

    门开了。

    苏晚站在里面。

    一身素衣，神色平静。

    像什么都没发生过。

    苏柔一瞬间有点不舒服。

    这种人，不哭，不怒，不恨。

    太干净了。

    干净得像根本不属于相府。

    苏柔微微一笑。

    “姐姐，昨日之事，是嬷嬷鲁莽了。”

    “她已经受罚。”

    她说得很轻。

    仿佛那一巴掌，从来没有发生过。

    苏晚看着她。

    没有回应。

    苏柔继续。

    “毕竟我们都是一家人。”

    “一家人之间，哪有隔夜仇？”

    她说到这里，往前一步。

    “我特意带了医女来。”

    “给姐姐看看脸上的伤。”

    话说得温柔。

    却一步一步，把“关心”变成“施舍”。

    周围丫鬟低头不语。

    谁都知道。

    这是来“收场”的。

    把昨天那一巴掌，变成“误会”。

    把苏晚，再按回“被原谅”的位置。

    苏晚忽然笑了一下。

    很轻。

    但很冷。

    “你来，是为了道歉？”

    苏柔立刻点头。

    “当然。”

    苏晚点头。

    “那很好。”

    她转身，让开一步。

    “进来。”

    苏柔心中一松。

    成了。

    她就知道。

    苏晚这种人，昨天不过是“逞强”。

    今天，只要给她一点台阶，她就会下。

    她带着人走进西偏院。

    院子破旧。

    但很干净。

    干净得不像一个“废院”。

    苏柔扫了一眼。

    心里更不舒服了。

    她本该住在这里腐烂的。

    怎么还能这么干净？

    屋内。

    苏晚坐下。

    苏柔坐在对面。

    气氛“温和”。

    苏柔柔声道：

    “姐姐，昨日嬷嬷冲动，是我管教不严。”

    “我替她向你赔罪。”
content_en:
The wind in the Prime Minister's Mansion is getting tighter and tighter.

    It was so tight that even the servants started to lower their heads when walking and did not dare to say a word.

    Because everyone knows——

    The legitimate daughter Su Wan, who dared to fight back after being slapped, is no longer "someone who can be bullied".

    But Su Rou didn't believe it.

    She couldn't believe it.

    In the afternoon, outside the west courtyard.

    Su Rou stood at the door.

    Behind him were two personal maids and a medical woman.

    She was dressed very plainly today, and even her hair accessories were a little less gorgeous.

    It looked like he was "coming to apologize".

    But the look in her eyes, no.

    It was a kind of calm that pressed against the knife.

    She raised her hand and knocked on the door gently.

    "Sister."

    The voice was almost soft.

    "Let me see you."

    The door opened.

    Su Wan stood inside.

    He was dressed in plain clothes and looked calm.

    Like nothing happened.

    Su Rou felt a little uncomfortable for a moment.

    This kind of person doesn't cry, get angry, or hate.

    So clean.

    It's so clean that it doesn't even belong to the prime minister's house.

    Su Rou smiled slightly.

    "Sister, what happened yesterday was because I was reckless."

    "She has been punished."

    She said it very softly.

    It was as if that slap had never happened.

    Su Wan looked at her.

    No response.

    Su Rou continued.

    "After all, we are all family."

    "How can there be an overnight feud between a family?"

    She said this and took a step forward.

    "I brought the medical girl here specially."

    "Show my sister the injury on her face."

    Speak gently.

    But step by step, he turned "care" into "charity".

    The maids around them lowered their heads and said nothing.

    Everyone knows.

    This is for "ending".

    Turn yesterday's slap into a "misunderstanding".

    Press Su Wan back to the "forgiven" position.

    Su Wan suddenly smiled.

    Very light.

    But it was cold.

    "Are you here to apologize?"

    Su Rou nodded immediately.

    "Of course."

    Su Wan nodded.

    "That's good."

    She turned around and stepped aside.

    "Come in."

    Su Rou felt relieved.

    It’s done.

    She knew it.

    People like Su Wan were just "showing off" yesterday.

    Today, as long as you give her a few steps, she will get down.

    She led people into the west courtyard.

    The yard is dilapidated.

    But very clean.

    It's so clean that it doesn't look like an "abandoned courtyard".

    Su Rou glanced at it.

    I felt even more uncomfortable.

    She was meant to live here and rot.

    How can it still be so clean?

    inside the house.

    Su Wan sat down.

    Su Rou sat opposite.

    The atmosphere was "mild".

    Su Rou said softly:

    "Sister, my mother was impulsive yesterday because of my lax discipline."

    "I apologize to you on her behalf."
title_en: Chapter 7 She said she found her deceased mother’s old person
